name: Ada Penrose
source_profile:
Ada Penrose (LN) — Ranger-Captain

Dame Ada is an experienced cavalry officer and one of Ashford's most trusted retainers. A capable horsewoman and practical commander, she believes the Rangers must maintain the confidence of ordinary settlers if the marquisate is to prosper. Although personally sympathetic to independent ranchers, she is fiercely loyal to Ashford and will enforce his decisions even when doing so risks her reputation.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 20 (source excerpt; may be partial)
